crossRefs.note: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

translations.web: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”
translations.bsb: “Very well,” Bathsheba replied. “I will speak to the king for you.”
translations.kjv: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
translations.asv: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
